entries.69ce42d2fbaf6eef: Accounting standards developed by the International Accounting Standards Board (IASB). The official Japanese translation is "Kokusai Zaimu Hokoku Kijun." They make it easier to compare the financial results of companies in different countries on the same yardstick. Some listed companies in Japan also choose to use IFRS.
